mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, COALESCE(u.`user`, f.user_name) AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.probe_mode AS probeMode, f.udp_echo_port AS udpEchoPort, f.target_health_config AS targetHealthConfig, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, COALESCE(u.`user`, f.user_name) AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.probe_mode AS probeMode, f.udp_echo_port AS udpEchoPort, f.target_health_config AS targetHealthConfig, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.user_id AS userId, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.target_health_config AS targetHealthConfig FROM forward f INNER JOIN tunnel t ON t.id = f.tunnel_id WHERE f.status IN (1, -1) AND f.target_health_config IS NOT NULL AND f.target_health_config != '' AND ((t.type = 1 AND t.in_node_id = #{nodeId}) OR (t.type = 2 AND t.out_node_id = #{nodeId})) AND f.id != #{excludeId}
